proof_scope: Tau required-node failure to pipeline-self-repair repair overlay

claims.proves: Tau records a failed required node through pipeline-self-repair, blocks downstream advancement, writes a repair ledger, and projects the repair category into the viewer.
claims.does_not_prove: ticket publication, watchdog repair success, provider semantic quality, or repair-category closure.

what_was_exercised: local commands declared in the fixture manifest
what_remains_unverified: semantic correctness, live services, LLM judge behavior, and release readiness

claims.description: A required-node failure becomes a blocking pipeline-self-repair category instead of a blind retry or skipped downstream edge.
